title: Grambank

about.name: Grambank
about.quote: The Grambank database currently covers 2,467 language varieties, capturing a wide range of grammatical phenomena in 195 features, from word order to verbal tense, nominal plurals, and many other well-studied comparative linguistic variables.
about.label: grambank.clld.org

about.name: Glottolog
about.quote: Glottolog provides a comprehensive catalogue of the world's languages, language families and dialects.
about.label: glottolog.org

here: Here: 300 languages from Grambank v1.0.3, spread over 100+ families (at most 8 per family, 11 for Indo-European so the familiar ones stay in) and each with at least 150 of the 195 features coded, as their position on the globe (A) and as their one-hot-coded grammatical features, unknown ones left blank (B).

grambank.text: Skirgård, Haynie, Blasi, Hammarström, et al. (2023). Grambank reveals the importance of genealogical constraints on linguistic diversity and highlights the impact of language loss. Science Advances 9(16):eadg6175.

glottolog.text: Hammarström, Forkel, Haspelmath, Bank (2021). Glottolog 4.4. Leipzig: Max Planck Institute for Evolutionary Anthropology.
